newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 3rd phone licence tender to start in 50 days.
newsitem.headline: Italy 3rd phone licence tender to start in 50 days.

text.p: The tender offer for Italy's third mobile phone licence will start within a maximum of 50 days, Posts Minister Antonio Maccanico was reported to have said on Monday.

A ministry spokesman said Maccanico had told a private meeting earlier on Monday that the regulations covering three European Union directives were ready and a parliamentary commission must give its approval in 20 days. The plan would then go to cabinet.
Maccanico had added that he believed that within 40 days and a maximum of 50 days the tender offer would be ready to start.
Earlier this month, deputy Posts Minister Michele Lauria said Italy would put its third mobile phone licence up for tender by June.
